requirement_text: User shall be prompted to verify their email upon registration for added security.
user_story: As a new user, I want to be prompted to verify my email when I register, so that my account is more secure.
technical_task: Prompt the user to verify their email address right after registration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user completes registration, when the account is created, then the user is prompted to verify their email.
Given an email that has not been verified, when the user views the account, then it is shown as unverified.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. The second criterion is an assumption about how verification status is shown.

requirement_text: System shall use Mapbox APIs for geolocation functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to use Mapbox APIs for geolocation, so that location features are provided by Mapbox.
technical_task: Integrate the Mapbox APIs to provide the geolocation functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Given a location feature, when a user uses it, then the geolocation is provided through the Mapbox APIs.
Given the implementation, when it is reviewed, then geolocation requests go to the Mapbox APIs.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which geolocation features are used is not stated.

requirement_text: The screen shall allow the moderator to filter/sort/view/edit/close sessions.
user_story: As a moderator, I want a screen to filter, sort, view, edit and close sessions, so that I can manage them.
technical_task: Build a moderator screen with filter, sort, view, edit and close actions for sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of sessions, when the moderator filters or sorts it, then the list is updated accordingly.
Given a session, when the moderator views, edits or closes it, then the action is carried out.

requirement_text: The public health agent can select to see the detail of a specific report.
user_story: As a public health agent, I want to select a report to see its details, so that I can review a specific report.
technical_task: Allow a public health agent to open the detail view of a specific report.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of reports, when the public health agent selects one, then the detail of that report is shown.
Given two reports, when the agent selects each, then each shows its own detail.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner shall implement backup and disaster recovery measures to prevent data loss in case of unforeseen events.
user_story: As a site owner, I want backup and disaster recovery measures, so that data is not lost in unforeseen events.
technical_task: Put backup and disaster recovery measures in place for Crafty kids corner.
acceptance_criteria: Given the site's data, when backups are made, then the data can be restored from them.
Given an unforeseen event, when it destroys the live data, then the data is recovered through the disaster recovery measures.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to create condo units and associate them with child parcels and addresses.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to create condo units and associate them with child parcels and addresses, so that units are linked to their land and location.
technical_task: Offer creation of condo units and linking of each unit to child parcels and addresses.
acceptance_criteria: Given a staff member, when a condo unit is created, then it is saved.
Given a condo unit, when the staff member associates it with child parcels and addresses, then the associations are saved.

requirement_text: Online registration and signup for memberships, job packages, postings, or resume database access shall be available.
user_story: As an employer, I want to register and sign up online for memberships, job packages, postings or resume database access, so that I can use these services.
technical_task: Provide online registration and signup for memberships, job packages, postings and resume database access.
acceptance_criteria: Given the website, when an employer opens the signup page, then registration is available for memberships, job packages, postings and resume database access.
Given an employer completing a signup, when it is submitted, then the signup is recorded.

requirement_text: The product shall be capable of handling up to 1000 concurrent requests.
user_story: As an operations manager, I want the product to handle up to 1000 concurrent requests, so that it copes with busy periods.
technical_task: Size the product to process up to 1000 concurrent requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given 1000 concurrent requests, when they are sent, then the product handles them.
Given fewer than 1000 concurrent requests, when they are sent, then the product handles them.
rationale: Role assumed: operations manager. The required response time is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall ensure software meets defined quality attributes.
rationale: The quality attributes are not named and the user's role in ensuring them is unclear.
clarification_questions: Which quality attributes are "defined" and where?
How should the user ensure the software meets them?

requirement_text: Users must be prompted to change their PIN on first use for security.
user_story: As a new user, I want to be prompted to change my PIN on first use, so that my account is secure.
technical_task: Force a PIN change prompt the first time a user uses a PIN.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user using the PIN for the first time, when the user signs in, then the user is prompted to change the PIN.
Given a user who has already changed the PIN, when the user signs in, then no change prompt is shown.

requirement_text: A patient chooses to view their patient specific instructions by selecting a link named "Patient Specific Instructions" under the View heading in the left hand menu .
user_story: As a patient, I want to select Patient Specific Instructions under the View heading in the left hand menu, so that I can read my instructions.
technical_task: Add a link named "Patient Specific Instructions" under the View heading in the left hand menu that opens the patient's instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the left hand menu, when the patient looks under the View heading, then a link named "Patient Specific Instructions" is shown.
Given the link, when the patient selects it, then the patient specific instructions are displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall be highly automatic to relieve the users of as many repetitive and tedious tasks as possible.
rationale: "Highly automatic" and "as many as possible" have no measurable criterion.
clarification_questions: Which repetitive and tedious tasks must be automated?
What does "as many as possible" mean as a testable target?

requirement_text: Web-based displays defined by the ASPERA-3 team shall be provided where any available ASPERA-3 data (as opposed to just the most current) can be used for science analysis.
user_story: As a scientist, I want web-based displays defined by the ASPERA-3 team that can use any available ASPERA-3 data, so that I can analyze more than the latest data.
technical_task: Provide web-based displays, as defined by the ASPERA-3 team, that can show any available ASPERA-3 data and not only the most current.
acceptance_criteria: Given available ASPERA-3 data, when a user opens a web-based display defined by the ASPERA-3 team, then the display is available.
Given older ASPERA-3 data, when a user selects it in a display, then it can be used for science analysis.

requirement_text: User shall be able to load a document with 50 activities and 50 connections within 1 second on the client side.
user_story: As a user, I want a document with 50 activities and 50 connections to load within 1 second on the client side, so that I can start working quickly.
technical_task: Make a document with 50 activities and 50 connections load in 1 second or less on the client side.
acceptance_criteria: Given a document with 50 activities and 50 connections, when the user loads it on the client side, then it loads within 1 second.
Given a load that takes longer than 1 second, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: If the error-condition existed longer than the pretime, it has to be logical false for at least the duration of the posttime to revoke the output signal.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want an error output to be revoked only after the error condition has been logically false for at least the posttime, so that short gaps do not clear it.
technical_task: Revoke the output signal when the error condition has been logically false for at least the posttime, if the error condition had existed longer than the pretime.
acceptance_criteria: Given the error condition existed longer than the pretime, when it has been logically false for at least the posttime, then the output signal is revoked.
Given the error condition existed longer than the pretime, when it has been logically false for less than the posttime, then the output signal is not revoked.

requirement_text: User shall input the received OTP for verification.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter the OTP I received for verification, so that my identity is confirmed.
technical_task: Provide an input for the received OTP in the verification step.
acceptance_criteria: Given the verification step, when the user enters the received OTP, then it is submitted for verification.
Given the OTP field, when it is left empty, then verification cannot be submitted.

requirement_text: The error type and its context data shall be made available to the application via an API call.
requirement_text_raw: The error type and its context data shall (3.3.12.4) be made available to the application via an API call.
user_story: As an application developer, I want the error type and its context data available through an API call, so that my application can react to errors.
technical_task: Expose the error type and its context data through an API call.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error has occurred, when the application calls the API, then the error type is returned.
Given an error has occurred, when the application calls the API, then the error's context data is returned.

requirement_text: Each quadrant of each floor shall have a thermostat which is to be used to provide temperature data to the THEMAS system. The initialization file shall contain a unique identifier for each thermostat that the system is to monitor. These identifiers shall be read from the initialization file and loaded into the THEMAS system during the initialization process.
user_story: As a building manager, I want a thermostat in each quadrant of each floor feeding temperature data to THEMAS, with unique identifiers loaded from the initialization file, so that THEMAS can monitor each one.
technical_task: Fit each quadrant of each floor with a thermostat, list a unique identifier per monitored thermostat in the initialization file, and load these identifiers into THEMAS during initialization.
acceptance_criteria: Given a quadrant of a floor, when the system is installed, then it has a thermostat that provides temperature data to the THEMAS system.
Given the initialization file, when the THEMAS system initializes, then it reads the unique identifier of each thermostat it is to monitor and loads it.

requirement_text: Customer shall be able to cancel an order and if canceled, money will be transferred to wallet to order food for next time (If Card Payment).
user_story: As a customer, I want to cancel an order and, for card payments, have the money moved to my wallet, so that I can order food next time.
technical_task: Provide order cancellation that credits the paid amount to the customer's wallet when the order was paid by card.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order paid by card, when the customer cancels it, then the money is transferred to the customer's wallet.
Given a canceled card order, when the customer orders food next time, then the wallet balance can be used.
rationale: Role stated: customer. Orders paid another way are not covered by the wallet transfer.

requirement_text: Require a traceable and auditable path from a claim payment or a transmission of a pay for performance payment to the clinical documentation supporting it.
user_story: As an auditor, I want a traceable path from a claim payment or pay for performance payment to its clinical documentation, so that payments can be audited.
technical_task: Link each claim payment and pay for performance payment to the clinical documentation that supports it and make the link traceable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a claim payment, when an auditor follows the path, then the clinical documentation that supports it is reached.
Given a transmission of a pay for performance payment, when an auditor follows the path, then the supporting clinical documentation is reached.

requirement_text: FTSS shall provide an API call to allow the ICP application to determine on which channel it resides.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS shall [SRS303] provide an API call to allow the ICP application to determine on which channel it resides.
user_story: As an application developer, I want an FTSS API call that tells the ICP application which channel it resides on, so that it knows its location.
technical_task: Provide an FTSS API call that returns the channel on which the calling ICP application resides.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ICP application on a channel, when it calls the API, then the channel on which it resides is returned.
Given ICP applications on different channels, when each calls the API, then each receives its own channel.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to complete processing of all onboard data, deliver the results to the End-to-End System and maintain availability for immediate resumption of operations once Correlator access is restored.
user_story: As a mission operator, I want all onboard data to be processed, the results delivered to the End-to-End System, and operations ready to resume once Correlator access returns, so that no data is lost.
technical_task: Complete processing of all onboard data, deliver the results to the End-to-End System, and stay available for immediate resumption of operations when Correlator access is restored.
acceptance_criteria: Given onboard data, when processing runs, then all of it is processed and the results are delivered to the End-to-End System.
Given Correlator access is restored, when operations are to resume, then the system is available for immediate resumption.

requirement_text: For details see "Feature List Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Tuner" .
requirement_text_raw: For details see "Feature List Telematic5STAR1 HU Entry Tuner" [RD3593].
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Feature List contain?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: User shall be able to see the most searched items on the title screen when starting the student handbook app.
user_story: As a student, I want to see the most searched items on the title screen when I start the handbook app, so that I can find popular information fast.
technical_task: Show the most searched items on the title screen of the student handbook app at startup.
acceptance_criteria: Given the student handbook app starts, when the title screen is displayed, then the most searched items are shown.
Given search activity changes, when the app is started again, then the shown items reflect the most searched ones.
rationale: Role assumed: student. How many items are shown is not stated.

requirement_text: The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.
requirement_text_raw: The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'
user_story: As a registrar, I want student management tasks to respond within 5 seconds and schedule generation within 30 seconds, so that I can work efficiently.
technical_task: Limit the response time of general student management tasks to 5 seconds and of schedule generation to 30 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a general student management task, when it is performed, then the response time is no longer than 5 seconds.
Given a schedule generation request, when it is performed, then the response time is no longer than 30 seconds.

requirement_text: User shall be able to tweet a certain event.
user_story: As a social media user, I want to tweet about a certain event, so that I can share it.
technical_task: Offer a tweet function for posting about an event.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event, when the user composes a tweet about it, then the tweet is posted.
Given a posted tweet, when it is viewed, then it refers to the event.

requirement_text: The system shall operate primarily offline, with networked authentication components functioning only when Radford University's systems are available.
user_story: As a student, I want the system to work mainly offline, with networked authentication working only when Radford University's systems are available, so that I can use it without a connection.
technical_task: Design the system to operate primarily offline and enable networked authentication components only when Radford University's systems are available.
acceptance_criteria: Given no network connection, when the user uses the system, then it operates offline.
Given Radford University's systems are not available, when networked authentication is attempted, then it does not function; and when they are available, then it functions.

requirement_text: If after the time PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime the relay is not closed (T30gStatusOpen equal 1) the error signal IODCCloseError has to be set to 1 for one cycle.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want IODCCloseError set to 1 for one cycle when the relay is not closed after PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime, so that a failed close is signalled.
technical_task: Set the error signal IODCCloseError to 1 for one cycle when T30gStatusOpen still equals 1 after PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime.
acceptance_criteria: Given PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime has elapsed and T30gStatusOpen equals 1, when the check runs, then IODCCloseError is set to 1 for one cycle.
Given the relay is closed after PPNM_IODCCloseAttemptTime, when the check runs, then IODCCloseError is not set.

requirement_text: System shall accommodate deposits of arbitrarily large files without size restrictions.
user_story: As a depositor, I want to deposit files of any size, so that I am not blocked by size limits.
technical_task: Accept deposits of arbitrarily large files without imposing a size limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a very large file, when a user deposits it, then it is accepted.
Given the deposit function, when its settings are reviewed, then no file size restriction exists.
rationale: Role assumed: depositor. "Arbitrarily large" is bounded in practice by storage, which the requirement does not mention.

requirement_text: The TCS shall have the functionality to transmit UAV mission plans to service specific mission planning systems.
user_story: As a mission planner, I want the TCS to transmit UAV mission plans to the mission planning systems that are specific to each service, so that plans reach the right system.
technical_task: Add a function in the TCS that sends UAV mission plans to service specific mission planning systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a UAV mission plan, when the operator transmits it, then it is sent to the service specific mission planning system.
Given a transmitted plan, when it arrives, then the receiving mission planning system holds the plan.

requirement_text: Logging in as a provider presents you with the Calendar page showing only that provider's schedule by default.
user_story: As a provider, I want logging in to show me the Calendar page with only my schedule by default, so that I see my own appointments first.
technical_task: Open the Calendar page after provider login with the schedule filtered to that provider by default.
acceptance_criteria: Given a provider logs in, when login completes, then the Calendar page is shown.
Given the Calendar page after provider login, when it loads, then it shows only that provider's schedule by default.

requirement_text: The system shall pre-filter images to remove artifacts.
user_story: As an image analyst, I want images pre-filtered to remove artifacts, so that analysis is not distorted.
technical_task: Add a pre-filtering step that removes artifacts from images before further processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given an image with artifacts, when it is pre-filtered, then the artifacts are removed.
Given an image without artifacts, when it is pre-filtered, then it is not changed in a way that adds artifacts.
rationale: Role assumed: image analyst. Which artifacts are removed is not stated.

requirement_text: After registration, users shall be directed to a profile customization page.
user_story: As a new user, I want to be directed to a profile customization page after registration, so that I can set up my profile.
technical_task: Redirect users to the profile customization page when registration finishes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user completes registration, when it ends, then the user is directed to a profile customization page.
Given the profile customization page, when the user opens it, then it allows changing the profile.

requirement_text: User shall seamlessly translate text input from one language to another in real-time, preserving meaning and conveying nuance effectively.
rationale: "Seamlessly", "real-time" and "conveying nuance effectively" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How is "seamless" translation measured, and what delay counts as real-time?
How are "preserving meaning" and "conveying nuance" assessed?

requirement_text: For details about operation modes see Specification Wireless Subsystem BR342 .
requirement_text_raw: For details about operation modes see Specification Wireless Subsystem BR342 [RD2459].
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What do the operation modes in the Wireless Subsystem specification require?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Movies shall be encoded and streamed via Windows Media Player 9.0.
requirement_text_raw: Movies shall be encoded and streamed via Windows Media Player 9.0.'
user_story: As a viewer, I want movies encoded and streamed via Windows Media Player 9.0, so that I can watch them in a supported player.
technical_task: Encode movies and stream them through Windows Media Player 9.0.
acceptance_criteria: Given a movie, when it is prepared for streaming, then it is encoded for Windows Media Player 9.0.
Given an encoded movie, when a viewer plays it, then it is streamed via Windows Media Player 9.0.

requirement_text: System shall implement robust security measures to protect users' personal information, ensuring user data confidentiality and integrity.
user_story: As a user, I want security measures that protect my personal information, so that its confidentiality and integrity are kept.
technical_task: Implement security measures that protect personal information from disclosure and from unauthorized change.
acceptance_criteria: Given personal information, when an unauthorized person tries to read it, then access is denied.
Given personal information, when an unauthorized person tries to change it, then the change is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Robust" is not measurable, so the criteria cover confidentiality and integrity only.

requirement_text: User shall be able to participate in one-to-one and group video chats.
user_story: As a user, I want to take part in one-to-one and group video chats, so that I can talk to others face to face.
technical_task: Support video chat between two users and among a group of users.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users, when they start a video chat, then they can see and hear each other.
Given a group of users, when they start a group video chat, then all participants take part.

requirement_text: Communication services shall restrict the use of "immediate" message passing services between virtual groups (from FCP to ICP) to tasks running in the highest rate group on the FCP. This restriction does NOT apply to the ICPs since they are running as simplex VGs.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS050] restrict the use of "immediate" message passing services between virtual groups (from FCP to ICP) to tasks running in the highest rate group on the FCP. This restriction does NOT apply to the ICPs since they are running as simplex VGs.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want "immediate" message passing between virtual groups from FCP to ICP restricted to tasks in the highest rate group on the FCP, so that only critical tasks use it.
technical_task: Allow "immediate" message passing services from the FCP to the ICP only for tasks running in the highest rate group on the FCP, and do not apply this restriction to the ICPs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task in the highest rate group on the FCP, when it uses "immediate" message passing to the ICP, then the use is allowed.
Given a task not in the highest rate group on the FCP, when it tries to use "immediate" message passing to the ICP, then the use is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The ICPs are exempt because they run as simplex VGs.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to create embeddable data summaries for websites.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to create embeddable data summaries for websites, so that I can show my data on other sites.
technical_task: Generate embeddable data summaries that can be placed in a website.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when the user creates an embeddable summary, then embeddable code for the summary is produced.
Given the embeddable summary on a website, when a visitor opens the page, then the summary is displayed.

requirement_text: In the list of in transit lab procedures the Lab Technician can update the status to received when the sample has been received in his or her lab.
requirement_text_raw: In the list of in transit lab procedures   the Lab Technician can update the status to received when the sample has been received in his or her lab.
user_story: As a lab technician, I want to update the status of an in transit lab procedure to received when the sample arrives in my lab, so that its progress is tracked.
technical_task: Allow a Lab Technician to set the status of an in transit lab procedure to received once the sample has been received.
acceptance_criteria: Given a lab procedure in the in transit list, when the Lab Technician updates its status to received, then the status is saved.
Given a received sample, when the list is viewed, then the procedure shows the received status.

requirement_text: User shall be able to choose the type of conversation (video chat, messaging, file transfer, etc.) after selecting the user to communicate with.
user_story: As a user, I want to choose the type of conversation after selecting who to talk to, so that I can contact them the way I prefer.
technical_task: After a contact is selected, offer conversation types such as video chat, messaging and file transfer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has selected a person to communicate with, when the user opens the options, then conversation types such as video chat, messaging and file transfer are offered.
Given a conversation type is chosen, when the user confirms, then the conversation starts in that type.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The list in the requirement is open ("etc.").

requirement_text: A detailed history of the actions taken on the case including the date and the user that performed the action must be maintained for auditing purposes.
requirement_text_raw: A detailed history of the actions taken on the case  including the date and the user that performed the action must be maintained for auditing purposes.
user_story: As an auditor, I want a detailed history of actions on a case, with the date and user, so that the case can be audited.
technical_task: Maintain a history of every action on a case that records the date and the user who performed it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user acts on a case, when the action is completed, then the history records the action, its date and the user.
Given a case, when an auditor opens its history, then all recorded actions are shown with date and user.

requirement_text: The Project Team must permit reasonable adjustment to the user interfaces of new functionality by project stakeholders when project schedule permits those adjustments.
rationale: "Reasonable adjustment" and "when schedule permits" are not defined, and the sentence is about project conduct.
clarification_questions: How much adjustment is "reasonable" and who decides?
When does the project schedule "permit" adjustments?

requirement_text: Worst case scenario must be established by the contractor and approved by the client.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor to establish the worst case scenario and have me approve it, so that testing is based on an agreed case.
technical_task: Have the contractor define the worst case scenario and obtain the client's approval for it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the project, when the contractor defines the worst case scenario, then it is documented.
Given the documented worst case scenario, when the client reviews it, then it is approved or not approved by the client.
rationale: Role assumed: client, as stated. The scenario content is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall have a login functionality for doctors, patients, chemists, and labs, with default passwords set up by the admin, and users can change passwords and log in using their own credentials.
user_story: As an admin, I want login for doctors, patients, chemists and labs with default passwords I set, so that users can then change them and log in with their own credentials.
technical_task: Implement login for doctors, patients, chemists and labs, with admin-set default passwords, password change, and login with the user's own credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account with a default password set by the admin, when the user logs in with it, then access is granted.
Given a logged-in user, when the user changes the password, then the user can log in with the new password.
rationale: Role stated: admin and the four user types.

requirement_text: For further details see Specification Wireless Subsystem WSub-795 .
requirement_text_raw: For further details see Specification Wireless Subsystem WSub-795 [RD2459].
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced Wireless Subsystem specification require?
Is the referenced specification part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The THEMAS system shall control the heating and cooling units that are defined as part of the THEMAS system.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the THEMAS system to control the heating and cooling units that belong to it, so that the temperature is managed.
technical_task: Have the THEMAS system operate the heating and cooling units defined as part of it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a heating or cooling unit defined as part of the THEMAS system, when the system needs to change the temperature, then it controls that unit.
Given a unit not defined as part of the THEMAS system, when the system runs, then it does not control it.

requirement_text: The Get Real site runs as an extension of the OUS site e.g. ~getreal.ous.edu~ Being part of the OUS domain will maximize Google and other search engine hits. The site runs on OSU servers.
user_story: As a site owner, I want the Get Real site to run as an extension of the OUS site on OSU servers, so that it benefits from the OUS domain in search engines.
technical_task: Host the Get Real site as an extension of the OUS site's domain on OSU servers.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Get Real site, when its address is checked, then it is under the OUS domain.
Given the Get Real site, when its hosting is checked, then it runs on OSU servers.
rationale: Role assumed: site owner. The search engine benefit is stated in the requirement as the reason.

requirement_text: The project Team must allow a reasonable time to conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) against the built functionalities prior to deploying the product to the production environment.
rationale: "Reasonable time" is not quantified and the sentence is about project planning.
clarification_questions: How long is a "reasonable time" for User Acceptance Testing?
Is this a requirement on the project plan or on the system?
